notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42967132/358d9355caaeaf4142c765e8fa1405bfd39b5b19.gif[/img]

Dear players,

Update 1.03 is live now!

Main bug fixed in this update
Changelist
- Energy production 
- Expedition - tribals on expedition 
- Expedition multiple cars
- Animals stuck 
- Disable blur during battle 
- Surviviors stuck after expedition 


*We were trying to mantain save compatibility, but we highly recomend to start a new game.
if the bugs still occurs in your previous save, please start a new game.


Thank you for your feedback and bug reports,
thanks to your involvement Post-Apo Builder will keep getting better and better.

More updates and fixes are coming!
Thanks once again. 


Regards
Septarian team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42967132/01c2909ea381cf9f34e9d1494b900ebce5894f02.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42967132/7583856076e9e709bc8c9e55eac189f362f18811.gif[/img]

Dear players, 

We have a good news for You

Update 1.02 is live now! 

- First quest time extended by 5 days
- Additional 5 surviors added at start
- Icons that will help you find important places on the map

*We were trying to mantain save compatibility, but we highly recomend to start a new game. 




Those who are guilty for making the bugs were queued to the punishment ring. (Right after they fix what they should)
